test.create_query: CREATE TABLE narrow_key_short_string (k UInt32, s String, k2 UInt32, s2 String) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE narrow_key_low_cardinality_string (k UInt32, s LowCardinality(String), w UInt32, t LowCardinality(String), v UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO narrow_key_short_string SELECT g % 1000, leftPad(toString(g), 12 + g % 4, '0'), g2 % 1000, leftPad(toString(g2), 12 + g2 % 4, '0') FROM (SELECT cityHash64(number) % 200000 AS g, cityHash64(number, 1) % 2000000 AS g2 FROM numbers_mt(20000000))

INSERT INTO narrow_key_low_cardinality_string SELECT g % 1000, leftPad(toString(g), 12 + g % 4, '0'), cityHash64(number, 4) % 100000, concat('category_', toString(cityHash64(number, 3) % 20)), number % 1000 FROM (SELECT number, cityHash64(number) % 200000 AS g FROM numbers_mt(20000000))
test.query: SELECT k, s, count() FROM narrow_key_short_string GROUP BY k, s FORMAT Null
SELECT k2, s2, count() FROM narrow_key_short_string GROUP BY k2, s2 FORMAT Null
SELECT k2, s2, count() FROM narrow_key_short_string GROUP BY k2, s2 SETTINGS enable_adaptive_aggregator = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT k, s, count() FROM narrow_key_low_cardinality_string GROUP BY k, s FORMAT Null
SELECT k, s, count() FROM narrow_key_low_cardinality_string WHERE w % 2 = 0 GROUP BY k, s FORMAT Null
SELECT w, t, sum(v) FROM narrow_key_low_cardinality_string GROUP BY w, t FORMAT Null
